description: Cultural Stewardship Experiment v2 is a token-free, ZKPassport-free version of the Cultural Stewardship Experiment's federated four-layer structure, built to test the same governance shape on plain votes instead of on-chain identity checks or tokens. The Primary Layer oversees the entire ecosystem and holds the shared treasury, while the Ideas Layer manages concepts and digital interfaces, and the Convergence Layers handle temporary sessions that manifest as online or in-person events.
